description.narrative: Development of of website on nuclear and radiation safety and security
Utveckling av websida om kärn/strålningssäkerhet och security

sector.narrative: Nuclear energy electric power plants and nuclear safety

description.narrative: SSM and the SNRIU have cooperated for several years now to set up a public Ukrainian website to promote nuclear and radiological safety, as well as nuclear security and non-proliferation. Amnesty legislation with the purpose of encouraging enterprises, organizations and the general public to turn in orphan radioactive sources to Ukrainian authorities is now in power. The website has supported promotion of the amnesty legislation and as well as the pilot project on orphan sources in Dnepropetrovsk region, led by US cooperation partners with outreach campaign. The website has also covered and published articles from few national and international events related to nuclear and radiological security, among the 14th Ukrainian nuclear security conference, which took place at South Ukrainian NPP in September 2017 and the GP Meeting in Kyiv in October 2017.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
